statement: Open-source LLM inference costs have fallen 30-50% annually since 2023, with Epoch AI putting the median token-price decline at ~50x per year (200x post-Jan-2024).
why: Falling token prices expand inference volume and pull GPU compute demand via price elasticity.

impact.mechanism: Cheaper tokens drive higher usage volume and total compute consumed.

evidence.excerpt: Inference costs have declined 30-50% annually for open-source models
prices declining between 9x to 900x per year
